jobs.title: Solution Architect (Customer Service Systems)

titleByLocale.fr: Architecte de Solutions (Systèmes de Service Client)

jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Solution Architect to design and deliver creative, scalable solutions across our global Customer Service business. In this role, you will shape the architecture of our service processes across SAP S/4HANA, SAP CS, SM & SD, Service Cloud (C4C V2), SAP Field Service Management, and Asset Manager. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, developers, and implementation partners to ensure robust, future-ready service solutions.

Aufgaben:
• You design and deliver high-quality solution architectures for the Epics and initiatives you own

• You elaborate solution concepts, perform requirements engineering, and create system and program specifications

• You coordinate internal and external development partners, including quality checks and testing

• You independently perform SAP S/4HANA CS/SM/SD/FSM customizing and document system setups

• You support global implementation projects and provide third-level support for global users

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in business informatics, computer science, engineering, or a comparable field

• 5+ years of professional experience, including 2+ years in a similar Solution Architect or Application Manager role

• Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA Customer Service (CS), Sales & Distribution (SD) as well as experience with Service Management in S/4

• Proven ability to create architecture deliverables in both waterfall and Agile environments

• Fluency in English, with strong communication and collaboration skills

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
To strengthen our Legal Services team at our headquarters in Uzwil, we are looking for a motivated and business-minded Legal Counsel who combines strong legal expertise with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues across our global organization, advising on a wide range of legal matters and supporting the business in achieving its goals in a compliant and commercially sound way.

Aufgaben:
• You advise internal stakeholders on a broad range of legal matters, with a focus on commercial contracts, IT law, and corporate governance

• You draft, review, and negotiate a variety of agreements, including customer, supplier, and IT-related contracts (software, cloud, SaaS)

• You develop and enhance contract templates, policies, and legal standards, while supporting the continuous improvement of legal processes and tools

• You identify legal risks, monitor regulatory developments, and translate them into practical, business-oriented guidance

• You collaborate cross-functionally and support governance matters, ensuring effective communication with stakeholders at all levels

Anforderungen:
• Swiss law degree and admission to the bar in Switzerland, combined with several years of relevant professional experience in a law firm or in-house environment, ideally in an international, industrial or technology-driven setting

• Strong expertise in contract law, IT law, and corporate governance, with proven experience in drafting and negotiating commercial and IT-related agreements

• Independent, structured working style paired with strong teamwork skills, business acumen, and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, along with a high level of integrity, reliability, and sound judgment

• Fluency in German and English; strong interest in digitalization, legal technology, and continuous improvement, combined with curiosity and a willingness to learn

Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

jobs.title: Solution Architect SAP C4C v2
jobs.description:
To strengthen our IT department, we are looking for a Solution Architect SAP C4C v2 to shape our global CRM landscape based on SAP Sales Cloud v2 and SAP Service Cloud v2. As the architectural lead, you will design scalable and integrated solutions that support Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Digital Customer Experience processes, while ensuring seamless connectivity across SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and other enterprise platforms. Working closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and development teams, you will drive architectural decisions, govern technology standards, and help define the future roadmap of our customer engagement ecosystem.

Aufgaben:
• You define and drive the target architecture for Bühler's global CRM platform and Customer Engagement ecosystem

• You design scalable integration and data solutions across SAP Sales Cloud v2, SAP Service Cloud v2, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and connected digital platforms

• You translate business and technical requirements into solution architectures, implementation roadmaps, and design guidelines

• You lead architectural governance, technical decision-making, and ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, integration, and security standards

• You collaborate closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and delivery teams to continuously evolve and enhance CRM capabilities

Anforderungen:
• University degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable qualification, combined with proven experience as a Solution Architect or Lead Architect in large-scale SAP CRM transformation programs

• Deep expertise in SAP Sales Cloud v2, SAP Service Cloud v2, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and SAP Integration Suite within complex global SAP environments

• Strong knowledge of enterprise integration architecture, including APIs, event-driven architectures, master data integration, customer data management, and enterprise integration patterns

• Ability to define architecture roadmaps, lead technical governance, and translate business strategy into scalable, secure, and future-oriented solution designs

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills in English, with experience working in Agile (SAFe) environments and influencing business and technology decisions at senior leadership level

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Als architektonischer Leiter entwerfen Sie skalierbare und integrierte Lösungen, die Sales-, Customer Service-, Marketing- und Digital Customer Experience-Prozesse unterstützen und gleichzeitig eine nahtlose Konnektivität über SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP und andere Unternehmensplattformen hinweg gewährleisten. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Product Ownern, Business Stakeholdern und Entwicklungsteams werden Sie architektonische Entscheidungen treffen, Technologiestandards regeln und die zukünftige Roadmap unseres Customer Engagement Ökosystems definieren. Aufgaben:
• Sie definieren und steuern die Zielarchitektur für Bühlers globale CRM-Plattform und Customer Engagement Ökosystem
• Sie entwerfen skalierbare Integrations- und Datenlösungen für SAP Sales Cloud v2, SAP Service Cloud v2, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP und vernetzte digitale Plattformen
• Sie übersetzen geschäftliche und technische Anforderungen in Lösungsarchitekturen, Implementierungs-Roadmaps und Designrichtlinien
• Sie leiten Architektur-Governance, technische Entscheidungsfindung und sorgen für die Einhaltung von Unternehmensarchitektur-, Integrations- und Sicherheitsstandards
• Sie arbeiten eng mit Product Ownern, Business Stakeholdern und Lieferteams zusammen, um CRM-Funktionen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und zu verbessern. Anforderungen:
• Universitätsabschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, kombiniert mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung als Solution Architect oder Lead Architect in großen SAP CRM Transformationsprogrammen
• Tiefe Expertise in SAP Sales Cloud v2, SAP Service Cloud v2, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP und SAP Integration Suite in komplexen globalen SAP-Umgebungen
• Umfangreiche Kenntnisse der Unternehmensintegrationsarchitektur, einschließlich APIs, ereignisgesteuerter Architekturen, Stammdatenintegration, Kundendatenmanagement und Unternehmensintegrationsmuster
• Fähigkeit, Architektur-Roadmaps zu definieren, technische Governance zu leiten und Geschäftsstrategien in skalierbare, sichere und zukunftsorientierte Lösungsdesigns zu übersetzen
• Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch, mit Erfahrung in agilen (SAFe) Umgebungen und mit Einfluss auf Geschäfts- und Technologieentscheidungen auf Führungsebene Wir bieten: Attraktive Urlaubsberechtigung Genug Zeit für Entspannung und persönliche Interessen - wir bieten von 25 bis 30 Tagen Urlaub pro Jahr je nach Alter. Attraktives Mobilitätskonzept Wir bieten eine OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Halbtax-Fahrkarte für CHF 365 + CHF 400 öffentlicher Nahverkehrsguthaben sowie eine attraktive First-Class-Fahrkarte oder kostenlose Parkplätze an. VIVA Restaurant Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitern ein tägliches Fitnessmenü ab 9.00 CHF. Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersversorgung Die Bühler Pensionskasse bietet Bühler Mitarbeitern eine unabhängige Pensionskasse, die eine zuverlässige finanzielle Absicherung im Ruhestand gewährleistet: www.pk-buhler.ch Gesundheitshafen Wir engagieren uns für die präventive Gesundheitsversorgung durch Laboranalysen, Massagen, Ernährungsberatung, Physiotherapie, Gruppenkurse und einen Betriebsarzt. Sportarten Wir fördern körperliche Aktivität durch selbstorganisiertes Zirkeltraining und Laufgruppen sowie Gutscheine für Update und Activ Fitness. Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen fahren Fahrzeuge, deren Teile mit unseren Maschinen hergestellt wurden. Bühler zielt darauf ab, Mensch, Natur und Wirtschaft bei jeder Entscheidung in Einklang zu bringen, indem es Lösungen entwickelt, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsbranche eröffnen. Wir bemühen uns, Innovationen für eine bessere Welt zu schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Daher arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Unternehmen und der akademischen Welt zusammen, um die Wirkung gemeinsam zu beschleunigen.

• Vous concevez des solutions d'intégration et de données évolutives dans SAP Sales Cloud v2, SAP Service Cloud v2, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP et des plateformes numériques connectées

• Expertise approfondie dans SAP Sales Cloud v2, SAP Service Cloud v2, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP et SAP Integration Suite dans des environnements SAP mondiaux complexes
• Forte connaissance de l'architecture d'intégration des entreprises, y compris les API, les architectures axées sur les événements, l'intégration des données maîtresses, la gestion des données client et les modèles d'intégration des entreprises
• Capacité de définir les feuilles de route de l'architecture, de diriger la gouvernance technique et de traduire la stratégie d'affaires en conceptions de solutions évolutives, sûres et orientées vers l'avenir
• Excellentes compétences en gestion des intervenants et en communication en anglais, avec une expérience de travail dans les environnements Agile (SAFe) et une influence sur les décisions commerciales et technologiques au niveau des cadres supérieurs - Oui. Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour de la nourriture produite avec des équipements Bühler. Un milliard de personnes conduisent des véhicules dont les pièces ont été fabriquées avec nos machines. Par conséquent, nous faisons équipe avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les universités pour accélérer l'impact ensemble.

jobs.title: Solution Architect SAP PS & SD
jobs.description: Are you passionate about designing innovative SAP solutions and shaping the next generation of business processes? Join our team and play a key role in shaping and implementing the end-to-end architecture for customer project processes across SAP PS & SD, and surrounding systems. Combining architectural responsibility with hands-on development, you will collaborate with Product Owners, development teams, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, integrated, and future-ready solutions for our global organization. Aufgaben: • You shape the SAP solution architecture for customer project management across SAP PS & SD and related custom solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic business objectives and enterprise standards • You design and specify technical solutions, either implementing them hands-on or guiding their delivery from concept to completion • You partner with Product Owners, Product Managers, and agile teams to refine, deliver, and operate solutions across the entire product lifecycle • You ensure seamless integration between SAP PS & SD, other SAP modules, and external systems to support efficient end-to-end business processes • You provide expert 3rd-level support, troubleshoot complex issues, and coordinate with stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of incidents and requests Anforderungen: • Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (e.g., HF, FH, university, or an internationally equivalent qualification) • 5+ years of professional experience, including 3+ years in SAP solution architecture, development, or a comparable technical SAP role; agile experience (Scrum, SAFe) is a plus • Deep expertise in SAP PS and/or SD is ideal. What matters most is a strong architectural mindset across SAP modules, so candidates with deep expertise in another area such as FI/CO who bring broad SAP knowledge and a track record of designing integrated solutions are equally encouraged to apply • Strong hands-on expertise in ABAP and ABAP OO development, including custom programs, enhancements, BAPIs, and BADIs; BTP, OData, and CDS experience is a plus • Proven ability to take ownership, proactively drive initiatives and solutions, solve complex problems, and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams, combined with fluent business-level English Wir bieten: Attractive vacation entitlement Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking. VIVA Restaurant We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF. Employer-funded pension plan The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch Health-Port We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. Sports activities We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato di progettare soluzioni SAP innovative e modellare la prossima generazione di processi aziendali? Unisciti al nostro team e gioca un ruolo chiave nella modellazione e nell'implementazione dell'architettura end-to-end per i processi di progetto dei clienti in SAP PS & SD e nei sistemi circostanti. Combinando la responsabilità architettonica con lo sviluppo pratico, collaborerai con i Proprietari del Prodotto, i team di sviluppo e gli stakeholder aziendali per fornire soluzioni scalabili, integrate e future per la nostra organizzazione globale. >

Aufgaben:
• L'architettura della soluzione SAP per la gestione del progetto dei clienti attraverso SAP PS & SD e le relative soluzioni personalizzate, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi strategici aziendali e gli standard aziendali

• Progettare e specificare soluzioni tecniche, sia implementando loro hands-on o guidando la loro consegna dal concetto al completamento

• Collaborate con Product Owners, Product Manager e team agili per perfezionare, fornire e gestire soluzioni in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto

• Garantisci un'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità tra SAP PS & SD, altri moduli SAP e sistemi esterni per supportare processi aziendali end-to-end efficienti

• Fornisci un supporto esperto di terzo livello, risolvere problemi complessi, e coordinare con gli stakeholder per garantire una risoluzione tempestiva di incidenti e richieste

Anforderungen:
• Laurea in Informatica, Informatica, o in un campo relativo (ad esempio, HF, FH, università, o una qualifica equivalente a livello internazionale)

• 5+ anni di esperienza professionale, tra cui 3+ anni in SAP soluzione architettura, sviluppo, o un ruolo SAP tecnico comparabile; l'esperienza agile (Scrum, SAFe) è un plus

• La profonda esperienza in SAP PS e/o SD è ideale. Ciò che conta di più è una forte mentalità architettonica tra i moduli SAP, quindi i candidati con una profonda esperienza in un altro settore come FI/CO che portano una vasta conoscenza SAP e un track record di progettazione di soluzioni integrate sono ugualmente incoraggiati ad applicare

• Forte esperienza pratica nello sviluppo ABAP e ABAP OO, tra cui programmi personalizzati, miglioramenti, BAPI e BADI; BTP, OData e CDS esperienza è un plus

• Prova capacità di prendere la proprietà, guidare proattivamente iniziative e soluzioni, risolvere problemi complessi, e collaborare efficacemente tra team tecnici e aziendali, combinato con fluente business-level inglese

Wir bieten:
Attraente diritto di vacanza
Abbastanza tempo per il relax e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanza all'anno a seconda dell'età.

Concetto di mobilità attraente
Offriamo una tessera di viaggio OSTWIND ZV/Z-Pass + mezza strada per CHF 365 + CHF 400 credito di trasporto pubblico, nonché una attraente carta di viaggio di prima classe o un parcheggio gratuito.

Ristorante VIVA
Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9, 00 CHF.

Piano pensionistico finanziato dal datore di lavoro
Il Bühler Pension Fund offre ai dipendenti Bühler un fondo pensione indipendente che garantisce una sicurezza finanziaria affidabile in pensione: www.pk-buhler.ch

Salute-Porto
Ci impegniamo nell'assistenza sanitaria preventiva attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale.

Attività sportive
Promuoviamo l'attività fisica attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e l'attivazione di fitness.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine.
Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nei settori alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

Join our team as an Export Compliance Engineer and combine your engineering expertise with international business, technology, and global trade affairs. You will work at the intersection of innovation, international trade, and regulatory compliance, supporting the worldwide delivery of advanced technologies while ensuring adherence to global export control requirements. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy analyzing technical products and documentation, solving complex challenges, and collaborating with colleagues across engineering, project management, supply chain, and global operations. • You maintain export control records, classifications, licenses, and audit-ready documentation to ensure full regulatory compliance and traceability

• You collaborate with engineering, project management, supply chain, and sales teams while driving process improvements, digitalization initiatives, and stakeholder training

• Independent, structured, and detail- and solution-oriented working style combined with strong cross-functional problem-solving capabilities

descriptionByLocale.en:
Join our team as an Export Compliance Engineer and combine your engineering expertise with international business, technology, and global trade affairs. You will work at the intersection of innovation, international trade, and regulatory compliance, supporting the worldwide delivery of advanced technologies while ensuring adherence to global export control requirements. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy analyzing technical products and documentation, solving complex challenges, and collaborating with colleagues across engineering, project management, supply chain, and global operations. As part of our Trade Affairs organization, you will help ensure that cutting-edge technologies can be successfully and compliantly deployed around the world.

Aufgaben:
• You evaluate products, technologies, software, and technical data to determine export control classifications (ECN/ECCN) and licensing requirements

• You review technical drawings, engineering documentation, product specifications, and technology transfers to ensure compliance with international export control regulations

• You perform screenings, risk assessments, and end-use/end-user evaluations while supporting global customer projects from offer to delivery

• You maintain export control records, classifications, licenses, and audit-ready documentation to ensure full regulatory compliance and traceability

• You collaborate with engineering, project management, supply chain, and sales teams while driving process improvements, digitalization initiatives, and stakeholder training

Anforderungen:
• University degree in a technical discipline such as Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable field; additional knowledge of international trade or compliance is a plus

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to understand and assess technical products, systems, drawings, and documentation

• Independent, structured, and detail- and solution-oriented working style combined with strong cross-functional problem-solving capabilities

• High level of responsibility, reliability, and integrity when dealing with complex technical and regulatory topics; experience with export control regulations or SAP GTS is advantageous

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with fluency in English; additional languages are a plus

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about securing digital identities and shaping the future of enterprise security architecture? As part of our continued investment in Cyber Security and Identity & Access Management (IAM), we are building a new IAM Product team and are looking for an experienced IAM Architect to help shape this capability further. In this newly created role, you will have the unique opportunity to define architectural standards, influence strategic direction, and build the foundation for scalable and secure identity services across our global organization.

Aufgaben:
• You design, govern, and continuously evolve enterprise-wide Identity & Access Management architectures across cloud, on-premise, and hybrid environments, ensuring alignment with business objectives and security requirements

• You define IAM standards, policies, and architecture principles for authentication, authorization, federation, privileged access management, and identity governance

• You design secure identity and access concepts for employees, partners, service accounts, APIs, and privileged users while ensuring compliance with security and regulatory requirements

• You act as a trusted advisor for business and technology teams, driving secure-by-design IAM solutions and supporting the integration of new applications, platforms, and services

• You assess identity-related risks, conduct security and architecture reviews, contribute to incident response activities, and collaborate closely with Cyber Security, Enterprise Architecture, Compliance, and external partners

Anforderungen:
• Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cyber Security, or a related field, combined with 5+ years of experience in Identity & Access Management within complex enterprise environments

• Strong expertise across IAM disciplines including authentication, authorization, identity lifecycle management, role design, federation, and Privileged Access Management (PAM)

• Hands-on experience with leading IAM and Identity Governance platforms such as Sailpoint, Omada, One Identity, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and PAM solutions

• Proven track record integrating enterprise platforms and applications, including SAP and Microsoft ecosystems, into IAM and Identity Governance processes

• Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and regulatory requirements such as ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, and NIS2, combined with fluency in English

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about shaping innovative industrial solutions and driving products to global market success? Join our team as a Product Manager and take ownership of a global product portfolio in grain handling, with a focus on ship loading and unloading equipment and belt conveyor systems. In this international role, you will drive product strategy, translate market needs into innovative solutions, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to strengthen our market position and deliver customer value worldwide.

Aufgaben:
• You manage a global product portfolio for grain handling solutions, with a focus on ship loading and unloading equipment and belt conveyor systems throughout the entire product lifecycle

• You define and execute product and portfolio strategies, including roadmaps, business cases, development priorities, and lifecycle decisions

• You analyze market trends, customer needs, technologies, and competitors to develop compelling product requirements, value propositions, and market positioning

• You lead product development and go-to-market activities, coordinating closely with sales, marketing, R&D, service, and regional teams to ensure successful product launches

• You act as the key interface between global stakeholders, technical teams, and international locations, driving collaboration, innovation, product expertise, and portfolio growth

Anforderungen:
• University degree in mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, business administration, or a related discipline

• Several years of experience in product management or sales within an industrial B2B environment; industry knowledge in grain handling, bulk material handling, or conveying systems is an advantage

• Strong business acumen combined with a structured, self-driven, and results-oriented working style

• International mindset with experience in cross-functional and matrix organizations as well as willingness to travel globally (20%-30%)

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in German and English, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

• Forte acume aziendale combinato con uno stile di lavoro strutturato, auto-guidato e orientato ai risultati

• Mindset internazionale con esperienza in organizzazioni multifunzionali e matrici e la volontà di viaggiare a livello globale (20%-30%)

Abbastanza tempo per il relax e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanza all'anno a seconda dell'età.

Offriamo una tessera di viaggio OSTWIND ZV/Z-Pass + mezza strada per CHF 365 + CHF 400 credito di trasporto pubblico, nonché una attraente carta di viaggio di prima classe o un parcheggio gratuito.

Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9, 00 CHF.

Ci impegniamo nell'assistenza sanitaria preventiva attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale.

descriptionByLocale.en:
To strengthen our IT department, we are looking for a SAP Application & Business Process Manager (LE/TM) to shape the end-to-end outbound logistics and transportation processes of our global organisation. In this role, you own the business processes and the corresponding SAP solutions along the outbound value chain, from delivery and shipment execution to transport management and the adjacent trade and customs interfaces. Working closely with business functions, Product Owners, development partners and Key Users worldwide, you translate business requirements into standardised, scalable process and system solutions and roll them out across our international sites.

Aufgaben:
• You manage, support and continuously develop business and SAP processes in Logistics Outbound and Transport Management

• You take ownership of end-to-end process analysis, standardisation, documentation and monitoring

• You capture, assess and prioritise business requirements and translate them into robust functional solution concepts

• You steer development orders with internal and external partners and ensure successful implementation in the relevant applications

• You run tests, deliver trainings, support global roll-outs and coordinate Process Managers, Key Users and Super Users worldwide

Anforderungen:
• Strong functional knowledge either in SAP LE or TM; SAP GTS, SD or PS as an advantage

• Several years of experience in IT, Logistics, Supply Chain Management or Freight Forwarding

• Degree in Business Administration, Business Informatics, Logistics or an equivalent qualification with relevant further training

• Comprehensive understanding of end-to-end logistics and supply chain processes, including adjacent areas such as Customer Project, Customer Service and Procurement and willingness to familiarize yourself with adjacent topics such as Trade Affairs, customs and export control (SAP GTS)

• Project leadership experience, strong analytical and conceptual skills, confident stakeholder communication, business-fluent English and intercultural competence in a global environment

jobs.description:
Join Bühler's Wheat & Rye Business Unit and help shape the future of grain processing. As a Senior Process Engineer Innovation Wheat & Rye, you will play a key role in driving technological advancements across the entire machine-to-market process. Reporting to the Head of Process Technology Innovation, you will leverage your process expertise to evaluate and develop innovative technologies, machines, automation, and digital solutions, while creating technology concepts for customer projects and strategic inquiries that deliver sustainable value to the global milling industry.

Aufgaben:
• You drive innovation in wheat and rye milling by developing future-focused process solutions from concept to successful implementation

• You lead the integration of process technology, machinery, automation, and digitalization to create efficient, cost-effective, state-of-the-art milling solutions

• You validate and optimize concepts through trials, pilot projects, customer applications, and selected plant start-ups

• You provide technological leadership and hands-on process expertise to support Sales, Quotation, Fulfillment, and R&D teams while building milling knowledge through training and coaching

• You bring deep milling expertise, strong problem-solving and communication skills, proficiency with Bühler control systems, fluency in German and English, and a willingness to travel internationally

Anforderungen:

• Solid understanding of Bühler milling equipment and control systems combined with systematic and efficient problem-solving skills

• Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in multicultural teams, manage conflicts, and build strong professional relationships

• Proactive, creative, and self-motivated personality with a market-oriented approach, professional presence, and willingness to travel internationally up to 30%

jobs.title: Senior Installation Supervisor
jobs.description:
As a Senior Installation Supervisor at Bühler you are managing and leading a team of technician required for the installation of big and / or complex projects (X-BU, type A projects). You would be responsible for the planning, preparation and execution of the installation supervision, within scope of work associated to the assigned project. Would you like to take on this new challenge? We look forward to receiving your application!

Aufgaben:
• You get sure that the personnel assigned is fully acquainted with the site specific rules, safety regulations and environmental protection measures and that they perform their work accordingly as well as you perform installation according to the specifications and engineering documents, taking into account the safety instructions, environmental protection measures and local regulations

• You monitor progress of construction against the program, and take steps to ensure the program is achieved. You initiate as required mitigation/ preventive actions to achieve target program timely with the support of the Site Manager or Project Manager

• You conduct or attend daily and weekly meetings with Bühler staff and subcontractors, ensure that the Site Manager and the Project Manager receive regular information updates as well as correct behaviour and good teamwork within the installation and commissioning team in accordance with company policy and local requirements/ regulations

• You ensure proper reporting while identify, document and communicate any deviations from customer contract as well as you are responsible for maintaining an intensive customer relationship and a high level of customer satisfaction

Anforderungen:
• Engineering degree as well as 10 years of experience as Chief Installation Supervisor or proof of sufficient skills

• Technical and commercial knowledge covering multiple disciplines

• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English, including the ability to interface effectively with people inside and outside of the company

• Strong planning, organising and priority setting skills, with a proven ability to manage teams

• Strong customer focus, sound judgment and decision making and problem solving skills

jobs.title: Senior PLC Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Join Bühler's Business Area Value Nutrition and help shape the next generation of automation and software solutions for advanced machine control systems. In this role within R&D, you will combine PLC programming, modern software development, and interdisciplinary collaboration to develop reliable, efficient, and high-performing solutions that support our customers in achieving outstanding process and product quality.

Aufgaben:
• You develop and implement PLC software for machine control systems, primarily using Siemens automation platforms; Rockwell knowledge is an advantage

• You design, implement, and maintain visualization software, including C# backend services and Angular-based frontend applications

• You analyze technical requirements and translate them into robust automation and software solutions aligned with engineering standards and best practices

• You collaborate closely with electrical, mechanical, process, and project teams, including close cooperation with our development team in China

• You support machine commissioning, troubleshooting, optimization, and 3rd-level support for machine control systems and related services, both remotely and on-site when required

Anforderungen:
• Degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a comparable technical field, ideally from a University of Applied Sciences or ETH

• Several years of experience in industrial automation, with solid knowledge of PLC programming, machine control software, relevant automation standards, C# backend development, and ideally Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS frontend development

• Good understanding of software engineering principles, including modular design, testing, version control, and documentation, combined with analytical thinking, strong problem-solving skills and deployment strategies as well as willingness to learn data science, data analytics, and machine learning methods for industrial applications

• Strong communication and collaboration skills in interdisciplinary teams, along with very good English and good German skills

• Willingness to travel up to 10% per year

Sei entusiasta dello sviluppo di giovani talenti e vuoi plasmare attivamente il futuro della formazione professionale? Insieme con il Capo dell'Apprendistato, svilupperai concetti di formazione innovativi, creerai condizioni ottimali per gli studenti e i dipendenti e dare un contributo importante alla riuscita attuazione della riforma professionale Futuremem. • Esperienza di leadership o potenziale dimostrato di svolgere una funzione di leadership e la volontà di completare la formazione di leadership appropriata

• Esperienza nella gestione dei progetti e nei processi di cambiamento di accompagnamento e una forte comprensione per quanto riguarda lo sviluppo educativo strategico e orientato alle competenze

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you enthusiastic about the development of young talents and would like to actively shape the future of vocational training? In this versatile management role, you assume the personnel and organizational responsibility for the areas of construction and project management within our vocational training. Together with the Head of Apprenticeship, you will develop innovative training concepts, create optimal conditions for learners and employees and make an important contribution to the successful implementation of the professional reform Futuremem. You combine leadership, strategic thinking and a strong service orientation with a passion for education and technical professions.

Tasks:
• They lead, promote and develop the employees of the areas of construction and project management and create a motivating and performance-promoting working environment

• You are responsible for the strategic and organizational development of your areas and actively participate in the implementation and further development of the professional reform "Futuremem"

• They further develop project management as a central future competence of vocational training and coordinate cross-divisional projects, processes and initiatives

• They ensure the optimal planning and control of personnel, resources, budget, cost centers and infrastructure and create economic and future-oriented framework conditions for training.

• They maintain close cooperation with internal clients, departments, HR and external partners and support vocational training in recruitment activities, career orientation events and challenging situations with learners

Requirements
• Completed technical vocational training, preferably in the field of construction, engineering or a comparable technical environment, supplemented by relevant higher professional or business education

• Knowledge of the Swiss vocational training system and in the field of vocational training, as well as experience and joy in promoting young people

• Leadership experience or proven potential to perform a leadership function and the willingness to complete appropriate leadership training

• Experience in project management and in accompanying change processes as well as a strong understanding with regard to strategic and competence-oriented educational development

• Strong communication skills in German and English

We are seeking a Product Manager to drive the development, profitability, and long-term success of Bühler's chocolate processing and service portfolio. The role is critical in shaping portfolio strategy, translating market and customer needs into innovative solutions, and ensuring sustainable business growth. You will work closely with customers, sales, service, R&D, engineering, and operations to strengthen Bühler's market leadership in chocolate processing.

Aufgaben:
• You drive portfolio strategy and growth by defining the roadmap, identifying market opportunities, and ensuring the long-term competitiveness of the product and service portfolio

• You manage the full lifecycle of products and services by leading new product introductions, portfolio optimization, standardization initiatives, service development, and phase-out activities

• You translate customer and market needs into solutions by gathering market insights, analyzing industry trends, customer requirements, and competitive developments

• You support commercial success by defining value propositions, pricing strategies, business cases, and commercialization plans for products and services

• You create and steer sales and marketing content by defining key messaging, supporting campaigns, and enabling sales teams with effective tools and training as well as representing Bühler at internal and external events

Anforderungen:

• Strong business acumen combined with technical affinity and the ability to translate customer needs into profitable business opportunities

• Very good communication skills in English combined with excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across functions, regions, and cultures

• Willingness to travel internationally (approximately 20–30%)

jobs.description:
Join Bühler as a Strategy & Business Development Intern – Future Food & Ingredient Platforms and help identify growth opportunities in sustainable food systems. You will explore emerging technologies, analyze value chains and market dynamics, engage with industry stakeholders, and assess business opportunities shaping the future of food, feed, and ingredient production. Based in the Grains & Food CEO Office, you will report directly to the Strategy Responsible and collaborate with Business Area leaders and C-level management. This 12 month internship offers exceptional senior-level exposure, independent work in an exploratory environment, and the opportunity to contribute to Bühler's future innovation and growth agenda.

Aufgaben:
• Explore and structure emerging opportunity spaces by analyzing value chains, market dynamics, customer needs, and industry trends.

• Identify high-potential applications and business opportunities by combining market insights with perspectives on emerging technologies and future production systems.

• Engage with customers, startups, industry experts, research institutions, and internal stakeholders to validate opportunities and build a fact-based understanding of the market.

• Map Bühler's internal strengths, capabilities, and ecosystem partnerships to uncover synergies, capability gaps, and value creation opportunities.

• Develop strategic recommendations, business cases, and decision-ready insights to support future investment and business development decisions.

• Prioritize opportunity spaces based on market attractiveness, strategic fit, scalability, and potential value for Bühler.

Anforderungen:
• You are a Master's student or recent graduate in Management & Technology, Industrial Engineering, Business Innovation, Business Administration, Food Science, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Life Sciences, or a related field.

• You bring genuine curiosity for innovation, sustainability, future food systems, and emerging technologies.

• You are interested in understanding how new technologies can be translated into customer value and successful business opportunities.

• You think in a structured way and can translate complex topics into clear insights and actionable recommendations.

• You enjoy working independently in an ambiguous, exploratory environment with limited predefined structure.

• You communicate confidently and effectively with both technical experts and business stakeholders.

• You enjoy conducting interviews, building networks, and interacting with external partners to validate ideas and opportunities.

• Previous experience in strategy, consulting, innovation management, market analysis, entrepreneurship, venture building, or technology scouting is considered a strong advantage.

• Sviluppare raccomandazioni strategiche, casi di business e approfondimenti pronti a decidere per sostenere le future decisioni di investimento e sviluppo aziendale.

• Priorizzare gli spazi opportunità basati sull'attrattiva del mercato, sulla vestibilità strategica, sulla scalabilità e sul potenziale valore di Bühler.

• Si comunica con fiducia ed efficacia sia con esperti tecnici che con gli stakeholder aziendali.

• Ti piace condurre interviste, costruire reti e interagire con partner esterni per convalidare idee e opportunità.

• L'esperienza precedente nella strategia, nella consulenza, nella gestione dell'innovazione, nell'analisi del mercato, nell'imprenditorialità, nella costruzione di impresa o nell'esplorazione della tecnologia è considerata un forte vantaggio.

jobs.title: Treasury Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Treasury Financial Analyst, you will be part of the Treasury team at our headquarters in Uzwil, which ensures the financial stability of the Group. They support our subsidiaries with insightful analyses, clear and reliable reports, cash planning and intra-group financing, contribute to group-wide liquidity management and coordinate intra-group dividend processes. You will also manage the KYC/UBO information requests and bank credit lines.

Aufgaben:
• You manage Treasury Reporting by analyzing monthly reports, commenting on results and supporting FX and daily cash management

• You drive cash flow planning by preparing Group cash flow forecasts and leading an AI enabled forecasting project

• You are responsible for internal financing by managing intercompany loans, dividends and cash pooling agreements

• You support governance and compliance by contributing to the annual report, processing KYC/UBO information requests and managing bank credit lines

• You contribute to strategic initiatives by supporting global Treasury and merger and acquisition projects

Anforderungen:
• Degree in a relevant field such as Finance, Business Administration, Economics or a comparable discipline

• Professional experience in balance sheet, income statement and cash flow analysis

• Structured and reliable working style paired with strong communication abilities and effective collaboration with internal and external stakeholders

• Experience in working with a Treasury Management System (e.g. Coupa) is an advantage

• Fluency in German and English

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Health-Port

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

• L'esperienza di lavorare con un sistema di gestione del Tesoro (ad esempio Coupa) è un vantaggio

• Fluency in tedesco e inglese

Abbastanza tempo per il relax e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanza all'anno a seconda dell'età.

Offriamo una tessera di viaggio OSTWIND ZV/Z-Pass + mezza strada per CHF 365 + CHF 400 credito di trasporto pubblico, nonché una attraente carta di viaggio di prima classe o un parcheggio gratuito.
